intro: Zimbabwe has about 17 million people, most of them Shona.

chapters.title: People
text: The Shona are the largest group and the Ndebele the second. Zimbabwe has 16 official languages, with English widely used. Most people are Christian.
Millions of Zimbabweans have moved to South Africa and Britain.

chapters.title: Learning
text: Zimbabwe has one of the highest literacy rates in Africa.
